scenes.setting: Audrey's promise of ten more diary pages for her blessing sets off a chain of guilty debts — Fors realizing she never paid for the angel that shielded her divination, Derrick vowing to dig up histories — while Mr. Fool quietly enjoys the power of a role model

The three pages: Mr. Door bargaining from his storm-lost prison, naming The Star for Evernight and declaring The Moon ownerless; the Angel Families of the Fourth Epoch — Abraham, Antigonus, Amon, Tamara, Jacob, Augustus and the rest — 'Ashes await those who fail to become true gods!'; then Bernadette's massage, the mentally-sutured Floren, and a Primordial Demoness named Cheek
scenes.text_anchor: “Ashes await those who fail to become true gods!
